note: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE: the issue URL is a placeholder. Replace it and rerun your own tests before using this as a PR body.
summary: Adds the paid-issue kit: ledger scoring, PR packaging, and the 120-minute timebox.
change_bullets: Added ledger.py with hard gates, effective-rate scoring, and a CSV ledger.
Added pack.py with a PR body builder and an evidence-pack validator.
Added timebox.py with six ordered phases totalling 120 minutes.
why: The kit needs a tested way to decide which paid issues are worth attempting and to package proof without unverifiable claims.
risk: The default thresholds are opinionated and may reject legitimate work; they are configurable in Policy.
rollback: Delete the paid_issue_kit package and the tests; no other module imports it.
checklist: Full suite run after the last edit

claims.text: The ledger rejects an issue with no stated amount.
claims.limit: Only the parseable-amount path is covered; amounts inside images are not read.

claims.text: The timebox refuses an out-of-order checkpoint.
claims.limit: Ordering is enforced; wall-clock honesty depends on the operator.

environment: Python 3.13.5, Linux, no third-party test dependencies
